title: 第22章 力士咒印第23章 一只羊
lines: “你为什么没有上班？”
半边脑袋被撞瘪下去的青年男人向苏午厉声追问。
苏午面无表情，没有回答这个已不能称为人的前同事‘王志友’的问题。
他盯着手里的蜡烛，
蜡烛剧烈地燃烧着。
但这燃烧速度又比被红灯笼映照时慢了许多。
蜡烛在‘王志友’踏进烛火扩开的光圈之中时，倏然燃烧到底，火苗即将熄灭。
苏午再度拿出一根蜡烛，接续上那将要暗灭的火苗。
‘王志友’距他只有三步远，这么近的距离下，他仍能眼睛一眨不眨，接续上烛火！
这只是一个游戏而已！
他要在这个游戏里，寻找到任何难题的最佳解决方案！
而不是在遇到难题时，就第一时间想要抱头鼠窜！
刚刚点燃的蜡烛再度剧烈燃烧起来，比刚才的速度更快——因为‘王志友’走进了火光映照的范围里！
橘色的火焰在对抗诡异的侵蚀，
‘王志友’亦因踏进这光圈里而浑身颤抖，发出不堪重负地骨肉摩擦声。
嘎吱，嘎吱！
这只诡的独脚像是陷入泥潭，再也迈不出！
有用！
苏午眉头舒展，举着烛火，拉住身后被吓傻了的江莺莺，就从‘王志友’身边三步外走过。
当火光不再笼罩‘王志友’时，它再度恢复了行动力。
转身追向苏午。
“你为什么没有上班？”
它在身后厉声怒喝。
“你为什么没有上班？”
又一道身影从灰雾里走了出来，和‘王志友’一齐压进了苏午周围的火光映照之地！
呼！
四十厘米长的红烛，眨眼燃烧见底！
苏午将手里早就准备好的两根蜡烛接续上火苗，递给江莺莺一根，而后摇响了脖颈上的帝钟！
“叮当当当当当当！”
无形声波向外扩散，传荡到了‘王志友’与另一个同事‘辛巧鸽’身上，两只诡的身体都弓成了煮熟的虾形。
而后，毫无预兆地，‘王志友’随着‘嘭’地一声，左边胳膊溅起点点鲜血，整条小臂落在了地上！
鲜血溅在了苏午的脸上。
他不为所动，继续摇晃着帝钟，接续着烛火。
背后一捆蜡烛迅速消耗，帝钟的响声不断传荡。
‘王志友’与‘辛巧鸽’的身上亦跟着不断传出爆响声，它们的肢体像是积木般随意散落！
只有两者的面孔保持了完整，没有一丝损伤。
它们已发不出任何声音。
倒在地上的脸孔对着苏午，血红的眼睛直勾勾盯着他。
content_en:
"Why didn't you go to work?"
The young man, half of his head smashed, asked Su Wu sternly.
Su Wu had no expression on his face and did not answer the question of his former colleague ‘Wang Zhiyou’ who could no longer be called a human being.
He stared at the candle in his hand,
The candle burned fiercely.
But the burning speed is much slower than when illuminated by a red lantern.
When 'Wang Zhiyou' stepped into the expanding circle of light, the candle burned to the end and the flame was about to go out.
Su Wu took out a candle again and connected the dying flame.
'Wang Zhiyou' was only three steps away from him. At such a close distance, he could still light up the candlelight without blinking!
This is just a game!
He wants to find the best solution to any problem in this game!
Instead of running away immediately when encountering a problem!
The candle that had just been lit burned violently again, faster than before - because 'Wang Zhiyou' walked into the range illuminated by the fire!
The orange flame is fighting against the strange erosion,
'Wang Zhiyou' also trembled all over as he stepped into this circle of light, making an overwhelming sound of flesh and bone rubbing together.
Crunch, crunch!
This weird one foot seems to be stuck in a quagmire and can no longer step out!
it works!
Su Wu frowned, held up the candle, grabbed the frightened Jiang Yingying behind him, and walked past 'Wang Zhiyou' three steps away.
When the firelight no longer enveloped 'Wang Zhiyou', it regained its mobility.
He turned around and chased Su Wu.
"Why didn't you go to work?"
It shouted angrily from behind.
"Why didn't you go to work?"
Another figure walked out of the gray fog, and together with 'Wang Zhiyou' pressed into the place illuminated by the fire around Su Wu!
call!
The forty centimeter long red candle burned to the bottom in the blink of an eye!
Su Wu lit the two candles that he had prepared in succession, handed one to Jiang Yingying, and then rang the imperial bell on his neck!
"Ding-dang-dang-dang-dang-dang!"
The invisible sound waves spread outward and reached 'Wang Zhiyou' and another colleague 'Xin Qiao Ge'. Their bodies were bent into the shape of cooked shrimps.
Then, without warning, 'Wang Zhiyou' made a 'bang' sound, his left arm was splashed with blood, and his whole forearm fell to the ground!
Blood splashed on Su Wu's face.
He was unmoved and continued to shake the imperial bell and continue to light the candle.
The bundle of candles behind him was quickly consumed, and the sound of the imperial bell continued to ring.
‘Wang Zhiyou’ and ‘Xinqiao Ge’ also heard explosive sounds from their bodies, and their limbs were randomly scattered like building blocks!
Only the faces of the two remained intact without any damage.
They no longer make any sound.
The face lying on the ground faced Su Wu, with blood-red eyes staring straight at him.
